Connect the App Store: the app's ids and its In-App Purchase and App Store Connect API keys, read
from their .p8 files. Asks for what is missing in a terminal; run it again to change them.

The keys are read from the files and sent to Voidhash, which stores them encrypted; they are never
printed.

Usage:
  voidhash provider connect app-store [flags]

Flags:
      --api-key <file>          The App Store Connect API key file (AuthKey_....p8)
      --api-key-id <id>         Its key id (default: from the file name)
      --apple-id <number>       The app's Apple ID: the number in its App Store Connect address
      --bundle-id <id>          The app's bundle id, such as com.acme.app
      --forward-notifications-to <url>
                                Also forward the store's notifications to this HTTPS url, such as
                                your own server
  -h, --help                    Show help for this command
      --iap-key <file>          The In-App Purchase key file (SubscriptionKey_....p8)
      --iap-key-id <id>         Its key id (default: from the file name)
      --issuer-id <id>          The issuer id of your App Store Connect keys (Users and Access,
                                Integrations)
      --json                    Print the API objects as JSON, for scripts
      --project <project>       Project to act on: its id, slug, organization/slug or name (default:
                                this directory's project, then your default project)
  -q, --quiet                   Print only ids, one per line
      --vendor-number <number>  Your vendor number, from Payments and Financial Reports

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Examples:
  voidhash provider connect app-store
  voidhash provider connect app-store --bundle-id com.acme.app --apple-id 1234567890 --issuer-id 57246542-96fe-1a63-e053-0824d011072a --iap-key SubscriptionKey_ABC123DEF4.p8 --api-key AuthKey_XYZ987WVU6.p8 --vendor-number 87654321
